paragraphs: Zone & Co’s ERP‑native AI platform tackles the pain of siloed financial data in NetSuite – I’ve built agents that run inside cloud services, turning raw data into actionable insights.
I deployed an agent as a Docker container on AWS Lambda using Lambda Web Adapter, ECR image pipelines, IAM execution roles and least‑privilege policies, ensuring secure, on‑demand execution.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, presenting it in a live stakeholder demo.
I have not used Azure yet.
